name: Multisensory Binding
description: Integration of cross-modal signals into unified perception: visual and auditory inputs binding into a single percept (e.g., McGurk effect, flash-beep fusion). Mechanism partially understood; involves temporal, spatial, and semantic congruence.
computational_signature: percept = integrate(vision, audition, if temporally_synchronized && spatially_proximal)
key_references: Stein, B. E., & Stanford, T. R. (2008). Multisensory integration: Current issues from the neurobiology of attention to the ecology of the organism. Journal of Neuroscience, 28(46), 11941-11953.
King, A. J., & Palmer, A. R. (1985). Integration of visual and auditory information in bimodal neurones in the guinea-pig superior colliculus. Experimental Brain Research, 60(3), 492-500.
empirical_evidence: Superior colliculus neurons show multisensory enhancement. Temporal window ~100ms for binding (Stein et al.). Inverse effectiveness: weak unimodal inputs show strong multisensory enhancement. Mechanism: largely converging feedforward inputs, some feedback modulation. Still debated whether binding is automatic or requires attention.

parameters.modulation_type: enhancement or suppression depending on congruence
